Rep: Hello, Northline Mobile customer care, Ellie speaking.
Caller: Hi. I need to report my phone as lost, um, I left it on a train this morning, and I'm worried about my SIM card. Somebody could run up my bill.
Rep: I'm sorry to hear that, I can help you right away. Can I get your mobile number and your account PIN?
Caller: The number is two-oh-two, five-five-five, oh-one-nine-six. PIN is, uh, eight-one-seven-three.
Rep: Thank you. Okay, I'm going to suspend the line so no calls, texts, or data can be used. Is that okay?
Caller: Yes please, do it.
Rep: Done. The SIM has been blocked. Now, would you like a replacement SIM sent to your address, or do you want to pick up one at a store today?
Caller: I'd rather pick one up. I have a spare old phone at home I can use.
Rep: Sure, any Northline store will do. Bring photo ID. They'll activate a new SIM on the same number at no charge, and you'll keep your plan and balance.
Caller: Do I lose my data allowance for this month?
Rep: No, it carries over. You've used about three gigs of your ten.
Caller: Great. And is there a way to track the phone from your side?
Rep: We can't locate devices, but you can use the phone manufacturer's find-my-device feature. If it's found, you can unblock the line in the app.
Caller: Okay. Thanks, Ellie.
